podcast.title: Friendship with Kurt Cobain
podcast.body: Michael Stein was a close personal friend of Kurt Cobain and was present at his drug intervention on March 25, 1994, later speaking about the event. "Michael Stein de Ren, el hablado varias veces y era un gran amigo personal de Kurt Cobain."

srcs.episode: El secreto de La muerte de Kurt Cobain
